import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('DanhSachHoaDon.xlsx', sheet_name='Sheet1')
df['d'] = pd.to_datetime(df['Thời gian'], dayfirst=True, errors='coerce')
march = df[df['d'].dt.to_period('M') == pd.Period('2026-03')]

# Exclude cancelled and returned orders
exclude = ['hủy đơn','Đã hủy','trả lại','Hoàn trả']
march = march[~march['Trạng thái'].isin(exclude)]

# Keep only orders with a customer code (not walk-in)
march = march[march['Mã KH'].notna() & (march['Mã KH'] != '')]

# Revenue = Tổng sau giảm giá
march['rev'] = pd.to_numeric(march['Tổng sau giảm giá'], errors='coerce')

g = march.groupby('Mã KH')['rev'].sum().sort_values(ascending=False)
top = g.head(5)
print(top)
print()
# Get customer name for top
top_code = g.index[0]
name = march[march['Mã KH']==top_code]['Khách hàng'].iloc[0]
print("Top customer code:", top_code, "name:", name, "revenue:", int(g.iloc[0]))
